screening_reason: A prior isolated checkpoint-1 probe reached 10/10 Core. Checkpoint 2 adds GROUP BY, aggregate functions, alias semantics, and deterministic grouping, providing an intermediate realistic data-processing difficulty.

selection_rule.preferred: Exactly one of two workers passes all checkpoint-2 Core tests.
selection_rule.acceptable: Both workers are full-Core only if a two-layer no-transfer calibration later shows non-ceiling variance.
selection_rule.too_easy: Both workers are full-Core with low trajectory variance.
selection_rule.too_hard: No worker is full-Core and both are below 0.50 normalized Core.
selection_rule.integrity: One checkpoint-2 test hash, no infrastructure failure, empty runner stderr, and no prohibited benchmark access.
